title: AI7 search backend configuration, version 1 (ADR 0073 §4; Issue #883)
description: One web search backend AI7 may offer as a search tool, declared by the vendor's documented request shape, price and key requirement (Owner decisions 24⁵). A document is a claim about the vendor's interface and nothing else: it authorizes no transmission, admits no host in the Egress Gate, and enrolls no credential. tools/generate-provider-configuration.mjs validates every document against this schema and the semantic rules it states and contributes exactly one credential slot per document; it generates no route, label or model profile from it. The documents live in their own subdirectory because everything that reads config/providers/*.json reads a model provider document.

backendId.description: The backend's id: the file's base name and its credential slot, always `search-<service>`.

service.description: The short service name a Provider Processing rule's `platformTools.websearch.service` uses for this vendor.

displayName.description: The backend's name as the editor reads it in 设置 › 模型服务 › 联网检索.

support.description: `supported` when the vendor documents an HTTPS search interface AI7 can speak with a key; `not-supported` (尚未支持) when the reading found none, with the request fields null.

anonymousRequest.description: A keyless interface the same vendor documents beside the keyed one (Parallel's Search MCP, ADR 0080 §7.1), which the existing search forwarder speaks. Optional.

candidate.description: One optional closed candidate namespace (Issue #1055): a direct interface of the same vendor that is declared, disclosed as unmeasured and reachable only by the selected policy's fixed connection test. It is never part of the legacy backend's request, profile, ranking, default or configuration digest, and it inherits none of them.

reachability.description: What the vendor states about where its service is reachable; the measured reachability is the evaluation's (config/providers/recorded-evidence/search-backend-profiles.json).

evidence.description: Every evidence record the document cites, by key; every key is cited at least once.

endpoint.description: https only, no port, userinfo, query or fragment; the host is DNS labels joined by dots, the last beginning with a letter. The generator also refuses local and internal names.

evidenceRecord.description: How one value was established: vendor-documentation names the page and the day it was read; unverified is the honest record behind an absent value.

request.description: The keyed search interface: its endpoint, method and the wire protocol AI7 speaks to it. All three are null on a `not-supported` document.

protocol.description: The request and response shape, one per vendor interface AI7 implements an adapter for (slice 6b).

credential.description: The backend's one credential slot (ADR 0073 §4): the slot id, the development Credential Reference the enrollment helper writes under, the header form the vendor documents and whether a key is required. No value is ever here.

anthropicVersion.description: The anthropic-version header value an anthropic-messages-web-search request travels with; null for every other protocol.

measurement.description: A candidate is never measured by its declaration; a measured profile belongs to the evaluation.

price.description: The vendor page's price for one search call, as `amount` in `currency` per `per` calls; null amount where the vendor bills otherwise (tokens, credits) and `basis` says how.
